en.text: The factory is the machine that builds the machine. It's way harder than the car itself.

zh.text: 工厂是制造机器的机器。它比汽车本身难得多。

en.text: Full Self-Driving is getting better every week. We're on track for nationwide Robotaxi by 2026.
en.context: Earnings call update on FSD progress

zh.text: 完全自动驾驶每周都在变得更好。我们正按计划在2026年实现全国范围的Robotaxi。
zh.context: 财报电话会议更新FSD进展

en.text: The goal of Tesla is to accelerate the world's transition to sustainable energy.

zh.text: Tesla的目标是加速世界向可持续能源的转型。

en.text: Tesla's Full Self-Driving will be the biggest value driver in the history of cars.

zh.text: Tesla的完全自动驾驶将成为汽车历史上最大的价值驱动力。

en.text: The Gigafactory is the biggest building in the world by footprint. It's a monument to sustainable energy.

zh.text: 超级工厂是按占地面积计算世界上最大的建筑。它是可持续能源的纪念碑。

en.text: Electric vehicles are simply better than internal combustion cars. The future is electric.

zh.text: 电动汽车就是比内燃机汽车更好。未来是电动的。
zh.context: 为电动汽车优越性辩护

en.text: Optimus will eventually be worth more than the car business. It will change the world.

zh.text: Optimus最终将比汽车业务更有价值。它将改变世界。

en.text: We're going to have a million Robotaxis on the road. Your car will make money for you when you're not using it.

zh.text: 我们将有一百万辆Robotaxi上路。当你不使用你的车时，它会为你赚钱。

en.text: The probability of a Tesla having an accident with FSD on is much lower than a human driver.

zh.text: Tesla开启FSD时发生事故的概率远低于人类驾驶员。

en.text: I think Tesla will be the most valuable company in the world. It's not just a car company.

zh.text: 我认为Tesla将成为世界上最有价值的公司。它不仅仅是一家汽车公司。

en.text: The Model 3 production ramp was manufacturing hell. We went through hell and came out the other side.

zh.text: Model 3的产能爬坡是制造地狱。我们经历了地狱并从另一端走了出来。

en.text: Tesla's AI team is the best in the world at real-world AI applications.

zh.text: Tesla的AI团队在现实世界AI应用方面是世界最好的。

en.text: The Cybertruck is the truck we've been designing in our heads for a long time.

zh.text: Cybertruck是我们长期以来一直在脑海中设计的卡车。

en.text: We need to produce 20 million vehicles a year to really make a difference in sustainable energy.

zh.text: 我们需要每年生产2000万辆汽车才能真正在可持续能源方面做出改变。

en.text: The transition to sustainable energy is inevitable. The question is how fast we can do it.

zh.text: 向可持续能源的转型是不可避免的。问题是我们能多快完成。

en.text: FSD v12 is a massive leap forward. It's essentially end-to-end neural net driving.

zh.text: FSD v12是一个巨大的飞跃。它本质上是端到端的神经网络驾驶。

en.text: Tesla Energy is going to be a huge part of our business. Megapack demand is insane.

zh.text: Tesla Energy将成为我们业务的巨大组成部分。Megapack的需求疯狂增长。

en.text: The cost of Tesla vehicles will continue to come down as we improve manufacturing efficiency.

zh.text: 随着我们提高制造效率，Tesla车辆的成本将继续下降。

en.text: I think by 2030, almost all new cars will be electric. The transition is happening faster than people think.

zh.text: 我认为到2030年，几乎所有新车都将是电动的。转型正在以超出人们预期的速度发生。

en.text: The Optimus robot will be able to do anything a human can do. That's the goal.

zh.text: Optimus机器人将能够做人类能做的任何事情。这就是目标。

en.text: Tesla's vertical integration is a huge advantage. We control the whole stack from chips to software.

zh.text: Tesla的垂直整合是一个巨大的优势。我们从芯片到软件控制整个技术栈。

en.text: The Dojo supercomputer is the most powerful AI training computer in the world.

zh.text: Dojo超级计算机是世界上最强大的AI训练计算机。

en.text: Robotaxi launch in Austin is going well. We'll expand to more cities throughout 2025.

zh.text: Robotaxi在奥斯汀的推出进展顺利。我们将在2025年扩展到更多城市。

en.text: The Model Y was the best-selling car in the world in 2023. That's a historic achievement for an EV.

zh.text: Model Y是2023年全球最畅销的汽车。这对电动汽车来说是一个历史性成就。

en.text: Tesla is not just an automaker. We're an AI and robotics company that happens to make cars.

zh.text: Tesla不仅仅是一家汽车制造商。我们是一家恰好制造汽车的AI和机器人公司。
